rules.accepted_credit_types: 1 CEU = 10 contact hours; 1 CME credit = 60 minutes
rules.alternatives: APRNs without prescriptive authority: current national certification in the practice role satisfies the continuing competency requirement (no hours). APRNs with prescriptive authority also need current national certification.
rules.audit_note: Online renewal is an attestation; random audits, proof required.
rules.notes: The 30 hours (min. 8 pharmacology + 22 in the practice specialty) apply only to APRNs with prescriptive authority, which renews with the APRN license. Biennium July 1, 2025 - June 30, 2027; all licenses expire June 30 of odd years.
